# ReceiptOne

> ReceiptOne is a receipt, expense and mileage tracker for freelancers, contractors and small businesses in Canada and the United States. Scan a receipt and it reads the merchant, date, total and tax amounts; log trips for mileage; and export PDF or CSV expense reports for your accountant or your own filing.

ReceiptOne organizes records; it is not a tax filing service and does not calculate tax refunds. Subscriptions can be cancelled in the app at any time.

## Canada

- [Landing page](https://receipt-one.com/ca): GST/HST/PST tracking and CRA-ready expense reports.
- Prices: Weekly CAD 4.99 per week; Monthly CAD 9.99 per month; Yearly CAD 129.99 per year. All plans include a 7-day free trial and the same features.
- Included: Unlimited receipt scanning, Expense & mileage tracking, GST / HST / PST tracking, CRA-ready expense reports, Multi-device sync, In-app support, iOS & Android apps.

## United States

- [Landing page](https://receipt-one.com/us): sales tax tracking and IRS-ready expense reports.
- Prices: Weekly USD 3.99 per week; Monthly USD 9.99 per month; Yearly USD 99.99 per year. All plans include a 7-day free trial and the same features.
- Included: Unlimited receipt scanning, Expense & mileage tracking, Sales tax tracking, IRS-ready expense reports, Multi-device sync, In-app support, iOS & Android apps.
